details: Bitcoin hovered near $80,901 on May 10, 2026, maintaining a bullish market structure across daily, four-hour, and one-hour charts. Buyers consistently defended dips, suggesting accumulation behavior rather than broad distribution.
title: Bitcoin Holds Above $80K as Momentum Builds

details: Bitcoin briefly surged above $82,000 on Sunday, May 10, 2026, boosted by strong ETF flows and improving macroeconomic conditions. The progress on the CLARITY Act is also contributing to positive long-term sentiment. Separately, Sui saw a significant 25% price increase, driven by Sui Group Holdings' decision to stake 108.7 million SUI.
title: Bitcoin Tops $82K, Sui Jumps 25% Amid Macro Improvements

details: A Bitcoin whale address, dormant for 12 years, moved 500 BTC, valued at $40.6 million on Sunday, May 10, 2026. During its inactivity, the value of these Bitcoin appreciated 89-fold.
title: Bitcoin Whale Moves $41M BTC After 12-Year Dormancy

details: Ripple's native token, XRP, reached a three-week high on May 10, 2026, surging almost 5% daily to nearly $1.50. Analysts are increasingly optimistic, with some predicting a "full-scale rise" and targets up to $1.82 if it decisively breaks key resistance levels.
title: XRP Breaks Out, Analysts Predict "Full-Scale Rise"

details: Market analysis suggests Bitcoin may face increased downside pressure if upcoming U.S. CPI data is higher than expected, potentially reinforcing the Federal Reserve's stance on delayed interest rate cuts. Bitcoin's daily chart shows a "rising wedge" pattern, where a break below the key $84,000 support could lead to a test of the $70,000 area.
title: Higher US CPI Could Pull Bitcoin to $70K

details: The ETH/BTC ratio was rejected below a long-term descending trendline on May 10, 2026, signaling continued weakness for Ethereum relative to Bitcoin. If this trend persists, analysts indicate the next major support level for ETH/BTC could be 0.0176 BTC, implying a potential 40% additional downside from current levels. On-chain data also shows rising Ethereum reserves on Binance, suggesting increased selling pressure.
title: Ethereum Could Drop 40% Against Bitcoin

details: Tech giants Google and PayPal have voiced their support for cryptocurrency as the foundational infrastructure for "agentic commerce," a futuristic model where AI-driven agents conduct transactions autonomously. This endorsement is seen as a significant step toward mainstream crypto adoption, leveraging the speed, security, and global reach of digital assets.
title: Google & PayPal Endorse Crypto for Agentic Commerce

details: Despite short-term fluctuations, analysts predict Ethereum could reach between $10,000 and $15,000 this cycle. This bullish outlook is driven by Ethereum's expanding role as a key settlement layer for tokenized finance, institutional custody, and exchange-traded products, supported by initiatives from major financial players like BlackRock and JPMorgan.
title: Analysts Foresee Ethereum Reaching $15K This Cycle

details: According to the historical 4-year halving cycle, some analysts, including Standard Chartered and Bernstein, are targeting Bitcoin to reach $150,000 by the end of 2026. This projection is supported by sustained ETF inflows and expectations of further Federal Reserve interest rate cuts.
title: Bitcoin $150K Target by Year-End 2026 Based on Halving Cycle

details: Digital Asset Holdings LLC, developer of the Canton Network, is reportedly raising $300 million at an approximately $2 billion valuation, with a16z crypto leading the funding round. The Canton Network is designed as a public blockchain enabling private information for mainstream financial transactions.
title: Digital Asset Raises $300M at $2B Valuation, Led by a16z Crypto

details: The U.S. Senate Banking Committee is scheduled to review and amend the CLARITY Act on May 14, 2026, a move anticipated to bring greater regulatory certainty to the digital asset space. Concurrently, BlackRock is planning to launch two tokenized money market funds, indicating growing institutional interest in the crypto sector.
title: US Senate to Review CLARITY Act; BlackRock Plans Tokenized Funds

details: Bitcoin's "kimchi premium" on South Korean exchanges recently rose to 1.98%, marking its highest level since the end of February. This increase signals a resurgence in demand from South Korean buyers after the premium had turned into a discount following the US-Iran conflict in early March.
title: Bitcoin Kimchi Premium Rises to 1.98%, Highest Since February

details: The broader cryptocurrency market is experiencing a general upward trend, with the PayFi sector leading gains with a 3.26% increase, and Bitcoin having returned above $81,000. Other sectors, including Layer1 (with Sui up 24%) and AI, are also showing positive movements.
title: Crypto Market Generally Rising, PayFi Sector Leads, BTC Above $81K
